items.stem: Why does the man suggest they call it a day?
options: They have got their work done.
They can meet again tomorrow anyway.
They are both anxious to go home.

items.stem: What does the woman say is a little tough?
options: Two months devoted to the same contract.
Working two months without any progress.
The man's long concentration on the project.

items.stem: What does the man say the woman must be in thinking they’ll finish by next week?
What does the entire managerial hierarchy want to see according to the woman?
options: More support from the board members.
The early implementation of the project.
The alignment of all sections of the contract.
